attendees.role: commissioner handling capital funds and paperwork

public_comment.topic: Announcing the DPW's Touch a Truck event on Friday, August 28th, at the TC Pacios building, noon to 2:30, free, with fire/police trucks and farm equipment.

budget_items.what_was_said: Three software invoices were submitted together in one day; as of this meeting none had been paid and the commission planned to follow up with the accountant.

budget_items.topic: North Cemetery expansion preliminary cost estimate
budget_items.what_was_said: The preliminary cost estimate for the North Cemetery back-lot expansion construction was given at this figure before contract specifications were finalized.
The estimated cost to hydro-seed the graded expansion area was given at this figure, discussed as cheaper/more effective than conventional seeding for a job this size.

The commission previously approved a transfer of capital funds for the expansion project; Bill controls that portion and the commission controls funds it separately approved, with bids expected to fit within the authorized amount.

budget_items.topic: Cemetery lot and burial fee increases
budget_items.what_was_said: Figures were used illustratively to explain how funeral directors would need updated pricing sheets once new lot and burial fees take effect; about a dozen already-committed buyers would keep prior pricing.
A figure was floated as a rough cost for a full-time employee to help with mowing and maintenance, to be requested from the town manager, ideally timed to budget season.

transfers.description: Capital funds allocated for the North Cemetery expansion, separate from funds the commission approved directly

decisions.decision: Bill would send the existing and proposed rules and regulations documents electronically to all commissioners for review.
The commission agreed to review the rules and regulations line by line at the next meeting.
Bill would draft a letter (email plus a mailed backup) to notify roughly a dozen area funeral directors of the new cemetery pricing before it takes effect.

Agreed that maintenance-related items (like a specific grass-height standard) should be reworded as general guidance (e.g., grass kept generally at 3 to 4 inches) rather than a rigid, unenforceable rule, developed jointly with the DPW superintendent.
Agreed to draft a letter to the town manager requesting funding for an additional cemetery maintenance employee, timed to budget season around the New Year.
Next meeting set for September 24th at 6 p.m.

minutes.headline: Cemetery Commission set the North Cemetery expansion bid schedule and moved to raise lot and burial fees
minutes.summary: The commission reviewed the North Cemetery back-lot expansion's contract specifications and bid timeline, including a small wetlands-buffer area needing Conservation Commission sign-off, and discussed hydro-seeding costs and phasing of the work. It also discussed notifying funeral directors of new lot and burial pricing, reviewing and reorganizing cemetery rules and regulations, and drafting a letter to the town manager requesting funding for an additional maintenance employee, with the next meeting set for September 24th.

what_happened.line: Commission set the bid schedule for the North Cemetery back-lot expansion, with a wetlands-buffer portion still needing Conservation Commission sign-off.
Commission agreed to draft a letter asking the town manager to fund an additional cemetery maintenance position, timed to budget season.
Commission moved toward raising cemetery lot and burial fees and will notify local funeral directors before the new pricing takes effect.
Commission agreed to review and reorganize the cemetery's rules and regulations line by line at its next meeting.

why_it_matters: Higher lot and burial fees would change what families and funeral homes pay for a burial in town.
A funding request for an added maintenance position goes to the town manager during budget season and could show up as a line in a future town budget.
The expansion's bid schedule and the pending wetlands review affect when new cemetery lots become available.
